description: This file contains functions and a command-line interface for adding and reading user data for Open5GS, including database interactions and subscriber data processing.

methods.name: add_user
methods.description: Constructs subscriber data dictionary for a user with specified parameters, including security and session info.

methods.name: read_from_db
methods.description: Reads subscriber data from a CSV file and returns a list of subscriber dictionaries.

methods.name: read_from_string
methods.description: Parses a subscriber data string into a list containing a subscriber dictionary.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main CLI function that initializes Open5GS client, reads subscriber data from CSV or string, and adds or updates subscribers in the database.
